```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)

```

```{r}
constitutive_sd <- c(9,7,11,8,9)
specific_sd <- c(13,10,15,14,16,12,4,2,1,6,5,9)
universe <- rownames(sd_norm)

geneClusters_sd <- list()

for (stage in specific_sd) {
  stage_num <- match(stage, specific_sd)
  geneClusters_sd[[stage_num]] <- 
    universe[which(sd_som$som$unit.classif == stage)]
}

names(geneClusters_sd) <- specific_sd
```

```{r}
compareClusterObj_sd <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_sd,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Ssalar.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

compareClusterObj_sd_nr <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_sd,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Ssalar.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
## per‑gene SOM class (names = gene IDs)
gene_class <- sb_som$som$unit.classif
names(gene_class) <- rownames(sb_norm)   # same matrix you trained on

##–– tissue‑specific clusters –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
tissue_df <- sb_som_info[
  sb_som_info$stage_specific     == TRUE  &
  sb_som_info$constitutive_class == FALSE ,
  c("tissue", "class_number")
]

##–– constitutive clusters ––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
constitutive_classes <- as.numeric(
  sb_som_info[ sb_som_info$constitutive_class == TRUE , "class_number" ]
)

##–– build the list –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
geneClusters_sb <- lapply(
  split(tissue_df$class_number, tissue_df$tissue),
  function(cls) names(gene_class)[ gene_class %in% cls ]
)

geneClusters_sb[["constitutive"]] <- names(gene_class)[
  gene_class %in% constitutive_classes
]

# optional tidy‑up
geneClusters_sb <- geneClusters_sb[ order(names(geneClusters_sb)) ]
```

```{r}
compareClusterObj_sb <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_sb,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Ssalar.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

compareClusterObj_sb_nr <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_sb,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Ssalar.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = FALSE
)
```
